title: Simplex rethinks software development with Codex
summary: Simplex boosts software development with ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex, reducing design, build, and testing time while scaling AI-driven workflows.
body: Simplex boosts software development with ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex, reducing design, build, and testing time while scaling AI-driven workflows.
summaryZh: Simplex通过集成ChatGPT Enterprise与Codex，优化了软件开发生命周期，缩短了设计、构建与测试时间。该案例展示了AI辅助编程工具在企业内部工作流中的实际提效作用。
